_about: Response modifiers — tokens that are neither incident type nor address nor unit. They appear in the utterance (typically between type and address) and currently bleed into incident_type. The parser must RECOGNIZE and REMOVE them, then park them in parsed.* (region-specific, not canonical fields).
_extension_note: Small closed set. Add others as observed. Recognized + removed BEFORE address extraction so they don't pollute type or address.
